findings.text: the evidence fragment, and the manifest's tests line ('8 + 3 passed'), report the caller-path gate as 8 passed, but tests/test_every_signal_caller_names_its_run_directory.py collects and passes 7 tests (4 at base d3cedc615, 7 at head 9da3d4ba9, reproduced by this review with --collect-only and a full run); the overcount by one is the sole figure in the record that does not reconcile with the gate it cites, while the unwatch '3 passed' and the 21/25 base-head totals are exact, so a reader of the fragment is told a number the file cannot show.

justifications.durability: the tests assert the exact record set rather than a loose presence check - a delivered signal must leave len(records)==2 with exactly one attribution and one delivered outcome, and the mutation that restores a caller pre-write fails the delivered arm - so a reintroduced duplicate is caught; the unwatch test observes the on-disk state at the killpg instant, so a write reordered after the signal fails it.
justifications.evidence: the named gate reproduces independently at head 9da3d4ba9 (25 passed EXIT=0; caller file 7 passed, unwatch file 3 passed), the manifest's machine-readable arms both completed with failure_count 0, so added_failure_count is 0 and added_failure_ids is empty, and the declared mutation restoring the dispatch run-stop pre-write reddens exactly the delivered case (negative-control.log, 2 failed 5 passed EXIT=1) by leaving two attribution records; the evidence fragment and the manifest's tests line both report the caller-path gate as '8 passed' when the file collects and passes 7, the one figure in the record that does not reconcile with the gate it cites.
justifications.fit: the change threads an optional project keyword through the existing writer/signal surface in the surrounding style, documents why project is its own field rather than folded into outcome_detail, keeps the pre-write-before-signal ordering, and adds no plan, sprint or ticket identifier to any name, comment or docstring.
justifications.goal_fidelity: one delivered signal now leaves exactly one attribution record and one delivered outcome and a refusal exactly one refused record, verified by grep (only routing.py calls _write_sender_record) and by the rewritten exact-count assertions, and every one of the eight _signal_process_group call sites passes run_dir (dispatch.py:6217/10086/10216, promotion.py:3789/5572, recovery.py:862/3042/7426) so no outcome is left without a file; unwatch, which previously wrote its own outcome-less record, now names the watch directory and carries the watched project as its own field.
